relazioni.condizioni: a temperatura ambiente (RT); confermata a 20 °C con esperimenti di trasformazione mediata dal solvente
relazioni.relazione_scritta: the two polymorphs are enantiotropically related (heat of transition rule)
relazioni.citazione: From the fact that the transition is endothermic, it can be concluded that the two polymorphs are enantiotropically related (heat of transition rule42,43).
relazioni.note: Enantiotropia dalla regola del calore di transizione (transizione endotermica). Il testo aggiunge: 'Form II° is thus the thermodynamically stable polymorph at room temperature (RT) and form I represents the high temperature form' e 'The fact that form II° is thermodynamically stable at 20 °C was also confirmed with solvent-mediated transformation experiments'.

citazioni: HTM and DSC experiments revealed that form II° transforms to form I upon heating at temperatures above 150 °C.

The weak endotherm in the DSC curve (Figure 4) at an experimental transition temperature (Ttrs,exp) of 159.8 ± 0.5 °C corresponds to the solid−solid transformation II° → I with a transition enthalpy of ΔtrsH = 2.1 ± 0.1 kJ mol−1.

TGA experiments and further thermomicroscopic investigations (silicon oil embedding) showed that no desolvation process is involved in this process, confirming that the reaction is a single component (polymorphic) transition.
of form I (heating rate: 10 K min−1).
eventi.note: Ttrs,exp = 159.8 ± 0.5 °C (DSC, endotermo debole). Altre scritture dello stesso passaggio nel testo: 'above 150 °C' (HTM e DSC) e l'intervallo 150−170 °C della T di transizione (parte sperimentale). Osservazione ottica: scurimento degli aghi della forma II° per sfaldatura e formazione di piccoli aggregati di forma I (Fig. 4). TGA e HTM in olio di silicone escludono una desolvatazione: transizione polimorfica di un solo componente. La decomposizione, lenta, comincia a ca. 160 °C (E5).

citazioni: A reversible transformation I → II° was only observed if the sample was mechanically treated (e.g., grinding at room temperature).
eventi.note: Il ritorno I → II° ha condizioni sue (trattamento meccanico): evento a parte, inverso di E1. Il testo non dice con quale tecnica sia stato riconosciuto ne' per quanto si macina. La Fig. 3 indica come trattamento meccanico 'for example, grinding'.

citazioni: Form II° is thus the thermodynamically stable polymorph at room temperature (RT) and form I represents the high temperature form, which nevertheless shows a high kinetic stability at RT.
No transformation occurred under storage at ambient conditions within 18 months.
eventi.note: Mancato ritorno I → II° a temperatura ambiente: relazione enantiotropa (termodinamica) e stabilita' cinetica della forma I non si contraddicono. La frase dice 'no transformation' senza nominare la forma: dal contesto (alta stabilita' cinetica della forma I) e' la I. Umidita' della conservazione non detta.

citazioni: This implies that the melting point of form II° is lower than that of form I, which melts at 231 °C with decomposition (second endotherm in DSC curve of Figure 4, overlapping with a broader endotherm, indicating the decomposition process).
of form I (heating rate: 10 K min−1).

citazioni: Single crystals of HH turn opaque when heated above 70 °C, while the original shape of the crystals is more or less maintained (pseudomorphosis).
In silicon oil preparations, the release of bubbles accompanies the darkening of the crystals and confirms the desolvation process (see Figure S1, Supporting Information).
Photomicrographs (dry preparation) showing the dehydration process of βRA HH to form I in a HTM experiment (heating rate ca. 5 K min−1).

The dehydration of HH involves a structural collapse, as despite the water interactions the O4−H···O4′ hydrogen bonds also break due to the conformational change, which is around 180° in the torsion angle for the p-OH proton in every second molecule.

citazioni: Forms I, II°, and HH were subjected to a gravimetric moisture sorption study at 25 °C (Figure 7).
The anhydrous phases absorb water and transform only to HH even at the highest RH value (90%).
The moisture sorption cycle of form I was completed within 48 h, whereas only ca. 25% of form II° transformed to HH within the same time period.
eventi.note: Ciclo di sorbimento a gradini del 10% fra 10 e 90% RH, cominciato al 40% RH (parte sperimentale): la RH a cui comincia la trasformazione non e' detta, 90% e' la RH piu' alta. Il prodotto e' solo HH, mai MH. Ciclo completato entro 48 h.

citazioni: Forms I, II°, and HH were subjected to a gravimetric moisture sorption study at 25 °C (Figure 7).

HH dehydrates only under rather dry conditions (5% RH and below) demonstrating its high stability. Under these conditions, HH transforms to a mixture of the two anhydrous forms. The complete dehydration process took ca. five days, although after one day 95% of the water was already released.
Moisture sorption isotherm of βRA performed at 25 °C showing a moisture sorption cycle of anhydrous βRA to HH and a desorption cycle of HH to a polymorphic mixture of forms I and IIo.
HH, in which water plays a structural role, is a very stable phase, as dehydration occurs only at temperatures higher than 60 °C or under the driest conditions (below 10% RH, 25 °C).

The dehydration of HH involves a structural collapse, as despite the water interactions the O4−H···O4′ hydrogen bonds also break due to the conformational change, which is around 180° in the torsion angle for the p-OH proton in every second molecule.

citazioni: βRA was purchased from Fluka (form II°).

Form II° was either prepared by slow crystallization from numerous solvents, including n-butanol, n-propanol, i-propanol, acetonitrile, ethyl methyl ketone, ethyl acetate, or by solvent-mediated transformation of any βRA form, using water-free solvents that did not form a solvate.

note: Disordine del protone del p-OH nella forma I (banda IR larga a 3432 cm-1 contro 3373 cm-1 della II°, superficie di Hirshfeld, calcoli): gli autori non lo escludono, statico o dinamico; non e' un cambio di forma. Previsione di strutture cristalline (CSP, solo calcolo): le forme I e II° sono i polimorfi piu' probabili; non e' un evento. Il testo cita idrati di stechiometria da 0.5 a 3 mol di acqua per acido da lavori precedenti, ma solo l'emiidrato e' stato determinato (nessun evento). Il testo cita un lavoro (rif. 12) che non ottenne nuovi polimorfi per cristallizzazione dal fuso e sublimazione; gli autori ottengono la forma I per sublimazione. Gli autori non trovano prove di un polimorfo triclino (ZZZEEU) ne' di un idrato con rapporto acqua/acido maggiore di 1:1. Nessun numero CCDC ne' refcode delle strutture di questo lavoro nel testo (i CIF sono nel supplementare). Le curve DSC/TGA della Fig. 6 hanno capsule DSC forate e 10 K/min per tutti i termogrammi; la TGA nella parte sperimentale dice 10-20 K/min con crogiolo di platino. La Fig. 3 (percorsi di trasformazione) non e' leggibile nel testo.
